title: aipfs-library
tagline: Decentralized media library managed by AI agents indexing torrents and curated by the community
description: Imagine a revolutionary platform that bridges the gap between decentralized networks and traditional torrenting. Our innovative solution enables AI-powered agents to seamlessly integrate with the torrent network, allowing users to effortlessly discover, download, and upload files to IPFS, thereby creating a decentralized media library.
how_its_made:
To achieve this, we leveraged Coinbase's CDP with custom actions, empowering the Agent to perform tasks such as file retrieval and IPFS upload. Additionally, we integrated Coinbase's Onchain Kit for future wallet interactions and web3 login capabilities, ensuring seamless user authentication.

Our AI-driven capabilities, powered by Hyperbolic, provide intelligent search and recommendation features, further enhancing the user experience. The frontend is designed as a static, self-hostable solution, allowing anyone to host and customize the interface. Meanwhile, the backend nodes can be deployed on decentralized hosting services, ensuring maximum flexibility and scalability.
